faq.q: Lanta AI 上的 Grok Imagine 免费吗？
faq.a: 是的。Lanta AI 新用户可获得 40 个免费积分，用于体验 Grok AI 视频生成。由于 xAI Imagine API 本身是付费的，Grok Imagine Video 会根据视频时长和分辨率消耗积分。

faq.q: Grok Imagine 视频最长可以多长？
faq.a: 通过 API，Grok Imagine 视频可生成 1 到 15 秒。在某些第三方平台或网站上，可用视频时长可能会因模式、套餐或使用限制而更短。

faq.q: 如何用 Grok Imagine 制作更长的视频？
faq.a: 不要试图用一个提示词生成完整长视频。把想法拆成多个短镜头。每次生成一个 5–10 秒的场景，使用最后一帧或视频延展继续故事，然后在视频编辑器中把片段剪辑到一起。

faq.q: Grok Imagine 支持图片生成视频吗？
faq.a: 支持。Grok Imagine 可以把静态图片变成视频。你可以上传源图片，例如产品图、人像、风景、动漫图片或概念图，并添加提示词说明你希望场景如何运动。

faq.q: Grok Imagine 支持参考图吗？
faq.a: 支持。Grok Imagine 支持使用参考图进行视频生成。API 允许一次请求最多使用 7 张参考图。使用参考图时，请在提示词中清楚标注每张图，例如“Image 1 is the character”“Image 2 is the outfit”“Image 3 is the background”。

faq.q: 为什么 Grok Imagine 会改变我的角色？
faq.a: 这通常是因为提示词过于宽泛，或参考图没有解释清楚。快速镜头移动、复杂动作、转脸、人群场景和远景也可能导致角色漂移。请使用清晰的正面参考图，并保持动作简单。

faq.q: Grok Imagine 适合专业视频吗？
faq.a: Grok Imagine 是制作短创意视频、社交媒体片段和早期营销创意的强大工具。但它并不能完全替代专业视频制作。

faq.q: Grok Imagine 处理真人照片安全吗？
faq.a: 是的。Lanta AI 会保护上传照片的隐私，不会公开分享你的图片。只有在获得许可时才使用真人照片。避免生成对真人具有误导性、性化、有害或涉及隐私的内容。

faq.q: Is Grok Imagine on Lanta AI free?
faq.a: Yes. New users on Lanta AI get 40 free credits to try Grok AI video generation. Since the xAI Imagine API is paid, Grok Imagine Video costs credits based on video length and resolution.

faq.q: How long can Grok Imagine videos be?
faq.a: Grok Imagine videos can be 1 to 15 seconds long through the API. On some third-party platforms or websites, the available video length may be shorter depending on the mode, plan, or usage limits.

faq.q: How do I make longer videos with Grok Imagine?
faq.a: Do not try to make a full long video in one prompt. Break the idea into short shots. Generate one 5–10 second scene at a time, use the last frame or video extension to continue the story, then edit the clips together in a video editor.

faq.q: Does Grok Imagine support image-to-video?
faq.a: Yes. Grok Imagine can turn a still image into a video. You can upload a source image, such as a product shot, portrait, landscape, anime image, or concept art, and add a prompt describing how you want the scene to move.

faq.q: Does Grok Imagine support reference images?
faq.a: Yes. Grok Imagine supports reference images for video generation. The API allows up to 7 reference images in one request. When using reference images, label each image clearly in your prompt, such as “Image 1 is the character,” “Image 2 is the outfit,” and “Image 3 is the background.”

faq.q: Why does Grok Imagine change my character?
faq.a: This often happens when the prompt is too broad or the reference images are not clearly explained. Fast camera moves, complex actions, face turns, crowd scenes, and long shots can also make the character drift. Use a clear front-facing reference image, and keep the action simple.

faq.q: Is Grok Imagine good for professional videos?
faq.a: Grok Imagine is a strong tool for short creative videos, social media clips, and early marketing ideas. But it is not a full replacement for a professional video production.

faq.q: Is Grok Imagine safe for real people’s photos?
faq.a: Yes. Lanta AI keeps uploaded photos private and does not publicly share your images. Use real people’s photos only when you have permission. Avoid prompts that create misleading, sexual, harmful, or private depictions of a real person.

sections.text: MindVideo AI prompts for three everyday projectsUse these examples as starting briefs. Use a front-facing photo of a skincare bottle on a simple background.PromptKeep the bottle upright and still. A soft reflection travels slowly across the glass while the camera moves slightly closer. Keep the cap, label placement, and background consistent. End with the bottle centered and clear space above it.What to reviewCheck the silhouette and label placement before adding a headline. If the bottle warps, try a locked camera with only the lighting change.02A portrait with subtle movementStarting pointImage to Video. Choose a clear portrait with the eyes visible and some space around the head.PromptThe person blinks once, gives a small smile, and turns slightly toward the window. Start with a setting and one event rather than a full plot.PromptA small bookshop on a rainy evening. From inside, the camera faces the entrance as a visitor closes a wet umbrella and steps through the door. Warm shelves in the background, reflections on the pavement outside, a slow forward camera move.What to reviewMake sure the entrance is readable before adding another event. This shot can introduce a story; the next action can be a separate clip in your edit.

faq.q: How do I start using MindVideo AI here?
faq.a: Use the generator on this page, choose Text to Video or Image to Video, add your prompt or source image, review the available settings, and generate. Your completed video will appear in the generation workflow for review and download.

faq.q: How can I keep faces and product details recognizable?
faq.a: Start with a clear image and keep the main subject easy to see. Ask for one compatible action and a restrained camera move. Review faces, hands, logos, labels, and edges, then simplify the motion if those details change.

faq.q: Can I use the generated video in ads or client work?
faq.a: Commercial use depends on the service, model, plan, and source material involved. Check the current Lanta AI plan terms and confirm your rights to every uploaded image, person, logo, character, and audio asset before publishing or delivering the result.

faq.q: Should I start with text or an image?

faq.q: Can I reuse a prompt from another project?
faq.a: You can adapt the same natural-language scene idea, but the result may change because each model interprets prompts differently. Preserve the subject, main action, environment, and camera direction first, then adjust one instruction or setting at a time.
